errors.text_span: and the Japanese curve slightly below
errors.evidence: The description states the Japanese curve is 'slightly below', which is ambiguous and misleading. In the plot, the order of the curves from highest to lowest at 500 iterations is Spanish (blue), Japanese (green), and then Korean (orange). The description incorrectly implies that the Japanese curve is at the bottom, when it is actually the Korean curve.

While the Korean curve ends near a vocabulary size of 3000, the Japanese and Spanish curves end at visibly higher values (approximately 3200 and 3400, respectively). Generalizing all three to 'approximately 3000' loses the distinction in performance between the languages.
